method: v1 KEYWORD-OVERLAP approximation against the QED (post-report call) ground-truth driver map -- NOT semantic/NLI matching. qed_driver_recall is the key new metric: did the model's retrieved evidence text share >=2 meaningful keywords with a real, management-attributed driver's label+quote (e.g. 'transaction processing', 'large deals slipped')? This is stricter and more diagnostic than family-level recall alone.
gold_source: QED post-report earnings-call driver extraction (D50/D52) -- management's own attribution, every driver quote-audited against the transcript. Supersedes the hand-curated gold map used by mining_scores.json above.
